rv.q: In all, this was a triumph and the true return of Bel Canto at the Metropolitan Opera.
And this revival conveyed it with aplomb—a decisive victory, to be sure.
His voice was consistent in tone throughout and well supported, making a pleasing and characterful performance.

cn.t: Critics praise this winning Met Opera revival of Donizetti's bel canto comedy, with Erin Morley and Lawrence Brownlee earning acclaim for their virtuosic coloratura and high notes in Laurent Pelly's charming production.
